10161.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster. Each time this skill is cast in battle, its DMG increases by 10%, up to 100%.

10162.name: Flurry Strike
10162.description: Deals Physical DMG 3 times to all enemies in a 3×1 grid area in front of the caster. The final hit has a 50% Base Chance to knock them back by 1 grid. For every 5% the caster's DEF exceeds the target's, this skill deals 5% more DMG to the target, up to 50%.

10163.name: Radiant Roar
10163.description: Deals Light DMG once to all enemies in a 1×4 grid area in front of the caster. Once the caster has 10+ stacks of Charge, consumes 10 stacks to cast this skill again, with a max of 1 additional cast per turn.

10164.name: Charged Slash
10164.description: Deals Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster and gains 2 stacks of Charge.

10165.name: Frost Protection
10165.description: Grants a Shield based on the caster's DEF for 2 turns. While shielded, taking Technique DMG has a 50% Base Chance to inflict 1 stack of Cold on the attacker for 2 turns.

10166.name: Flora Summon
10166.description: Summons 1 Flora behind the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, starts in Stealth, and remains for up to 3 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

10167.name: Wraithguard Summon
10167.description: Summons 1 Wraithguard within 4 grids of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (Can only be cast once per battle.)

10168.name: Eclipse Burst
10168.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, dealing Dark DMG once, with a 50% base chance to inflict Slow 1 for 2 turns. If the target carries Erosion, instantly triggers Erosion effect 12 times.

10169.name: Ravenous Curse
10169.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Ravenous Mark for 2 turns.

10170.name: Shadow Wraith
10170.description: Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster and all enemies in a 1-grid square area around that target, then ricochets to 1 random enemy within 3 grids of that target, ricocheting up to 2 times. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)

10171.name: Merciful Wish
10171.description: Select a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Grants DMG Reduction to all allied characters within 3 grids of the target grid for 2 turns. This effect is unique, and can randomly dispel 1 Ailment or Debuff. (Can be cast while in Taunt or Frenzy.)

10172.name: Tempest Call
10172.description: Summons 4 Wind Orbs around the caster.

10173.name: Whirling Blades
10173.description: Selects a grid within 2 grids of the caster. Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the target grid.

10174.name: Void Slash
10174.description: Deals Physical DMG 6 times to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

10175.name: Shadow Devour
10175.description: Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the caster, with a 20% Lifesteal effect.

10176.name: Ignition Strike
10176.description: Teleports to an empty grid next to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage within 5 grids of the caster and deals Fire DMG once.

10177.name: Starfire Annihilation
10177.description: Deals Fire DMG once to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage within 1 grid of the caster. For every 10% HP lost by the target, this skill deals 20% more DMG, up to a max of 200% increase.

10178.name: Frost Shatter
10178.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, dealing Water DMG once with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

10179.name: Ravaging Flame
10179.description: Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 3-grid circular area around the caster, with a 40% chance to inflict Burn on grids within range.

10180.name: Gale Plume
10180.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 6 times to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid, with an 80% base chance to inflict Laceration for 1 turn.

10181.name: Backdraft Strike
10181.description: Deals Wind DMG 3 times to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. If the target is within 3 grids of the caster, the caster retreats 1 grid.

10182.name: Void Lightwave
10182.description: Deals Light DMG once to all enemies in a 1×7 grid area in front of the caster. Starting with the 3rd hit, each subsequent hit against the same target deals 40% less DMG. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)

10183.name: Lightning Grid
10183.description: Randomly summons 8 Ball Lightnings in a 3×5 area in front of the caster. Upon landing, each Ball Lightning deals Light DMG and chains to 1 random enemy within 2 grids of the target grid. (Prioritizes the skill range that contains large targets.)

10502.name: Lightning Mystery
10502.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 30% chance to trigger Thunder Strike that deals additional Light DMG once.

10503.name: Fiery Burst
10503.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Fire Crit DMG to an enemy, deals additional Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target.

10509.name: Eye for an Eye
10509.description: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, increases the DMG of the caster's next Technique attack. This effect can stack up to 10 times.

10512.name: Unstable Aura
10512.description: When the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 25% chance to trigger Aura, dealing additional Wind DMG once, with a 60% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

10513.name: Gale Shield
10513.description: Grants a shield based on the caster's max HP before battle starts. When the shield disappears, deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the caster, with a 100% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

10516.name: Pursuit of Victory
10516.description: Increases the Sunder Efficiency of the caster's skills. Additionally, deals increased Technique DMG to enemies affected by ailments or debuffs.

10518.name: Indomitable Will
10518.description: Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, survives with 1 HP, enters the Indomitable status for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled), and heals the caster once.

10519.name: Blade Siphon
10519.description: Heals the caster once each time the caster's Technique deals Crit DMG to an enemy.

10530.name: Soul Impact
10530.description: When the caster's summon dies or expires, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of it.

10531.name: Resurrection
10531.description: When an allied adventurer dies, immediately revives and heals them once, granting Revitalization for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This Charm can only trigger once per battle. Before battle starts, if multiple allied adventurers are dead, reviving the one with the highest Power first.

10537.name: Counter Blade
10537.description: When damaged by an enemy's Technique within 2 grids of the caster, there is a 50% chance to counterattack, dealing Physical DMG once to the attacker.

10539.name: Pure Protection
10539.description: In battle, each time the caster's HP drops below 50%, grants a shield to the caster based on DEF.

10540.name: Defensive Assault
10540.description: Grants an ATK boost when the caster is shielded.

10541.name: Rebound
10541.description: Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF.

10542.name: Stone Skin
10542.description: Reduces the caster's DMG taken for 1 turn for every 1 instances of Technique DMG the caster takes. This effect can stack up to 9 times.

10543.name: Blazing Momentum
10543.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Crit DMG to an enemy, deals additional Fire DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the target.

10544.name: Blade of Lament
10544.description: Each time a Technique deals DMG to an enemy, triggers a Lifesteal effect, up to 50% of the caster's max HP.

10545.name: Soul Splash
10545.description: The caster's Single-Hit Techniques deal increased DMG. Killing an enemy deals additional Fire True DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid where DMG is dealt, equal to 60% of overkill DMG.

10546.name: Relentless Frenzy
10546.description: Increase the caster's SPD for each enemy unit killed. Stacks up to 4 times.

10547.name: Desperate Valor
10547.description: Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 15% HP lost. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

10556.name: Void Bubble
10556.description: When the caster's HP drops below 50% for the first time in a battle, grants a shield to the caster based on max HP for 2 turns and Dodge for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).

10557.name: Shattering Ice
10557.description: When a target frozen by the caster removes the Frozen state, additionally deals Water DMG once.

10559.name: Insight
10559.description: Increases the caster's Effect Hit Rate.

10560.name: Water to Ice
10560.description: When the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to trigger Condensation, dealing additional Water DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

10561.name: Flaming Path
10561.description: When the caster starts to move in their turn, there is a 30% chance to inflict Burn to grids within 1 grid of the caster.

10562.name: Blade Tempest
10562.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 40% chance to trigger Sword Gale that deals additional Wind DMG once.

10563.name: Ripple Impact
10563.description: When the caster's shield is fully broken, deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster, with a 100% base chance to inflict 3 stacks of Cold for 2 turns.

10564.name: Blazing Clash
10564.description: Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 4 Techniques used. Stacks up to 3 times.

10565.name: Shadow Erosion
10565.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Dark DMG to an enemy, there is a 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.

10566.name: Repelling Wind
10566.description: Has a 75% chance to trigger Repelling Wind when an enemy actively enters within 2 grids of the caster, dealing Wind DMG once, with a 100% base chance to knock them back 2 grids. (Triggers again if they approach repeatedly)

10567.name: Reflective Armor
10567.description: While shielded, the caster reflects a percentage of DMG taken back to the attacker as Light DMG once for each Technique attack received.

10568.name: Piercing Assault
10568.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, the caster ignores a portion of the target's DEF. The DEF ignorance increases by 10% for each buff the caster has, stacking up to 3 times.

10569.name: Wind's Shadow
10569.description: Whenever Wind DMG is dealt 3 times to an enemy with Techniques, there is a 30% chance to deal additional Wind DMG once and a 50% base chance to delay the target‘s action by 20%.

10570.name: Overhealing
10570.description: Has a 30% chance to additionally heal all allies within 1 grid of the target each time the caster heals allies with a Technique.

10571.name: Iron Fortress
10571.description: Before battle starts, increases the DEF of all allied characters within a 3-grid square area of the caster by a percentage of the caster's own DEF. This effect is unique and cannot be dispelled.

10572.name: Source of Vitality
10572.description: Heals the caster once at the start of the caster's turn.

10573.name: Overload Protection
10573.description: Within a single turn, each time the caster loses over 15% of max HP, grants the caster a shield based on their max HP for 2 turns.

10574.name: Blade of Judgment
10574.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, inflicts 1 stack of Mark on them. When Mark stacks to 10, deals Physical DMG once to the target.

10575.name: Soul Protection
10575.description: Before battle starts, converts 50% of the caster's current HP into a shield. Restores HP proportional to the remaining shield strength upon victory.

10576.name: Raging Wildfire
10576.description: Has a 20% chance to inflict Burn to grids within range when casting a Fire Technique.

10577.name: Radiant Sear
10577.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to deal additional Light DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.

10578.name: Curse Resonance
10578.description: For each ailment or debuff the target carries, Technique DMG dealt by the caster to that target increases. Stacks up to 3 times.

10579.name: Aberrancy
10579.description: When taking DMG, if the attacker is affected by ailment or debuff, reduces DMG taken by the caster.

10580.name: Oath of Vigil
10580.description: At the start of the caster's turn, grants Vigil to the allied adventurer with the lowest HP percentage, taking 50% of DMG for them. Reduces DMG taken from this effect, with an additional 1% reduction for every 1% the caster's DEF exceeds the protected unit's. This effect cannot be dispelled.

10581.name: Potential Rebirth
10581.description: Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, the caster survives with 1 HP, heals the caster once, and dispels all dispellable effects on the caster.

10582.name: Frame of Battles
10582.description: Reduces the caster's DMG taken for every 15% HP lost. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

10584.name: Summoning Pact
10584.description: Upon casting a summoning Technique, consumes 2% of the caster's max HP to increase the summon's HP. Restores all HP consumed by this Charm if the caster survives until victory.

10585.name: Linked Misfortune
10585.description: Each time the caster inflicts Erosion on an enemy, there's a 60% chance to inflict Erosion again.

10586.name: Shadow Vengeance
10586.description: Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, the caster survives with 1 HP and enters Shadow Form, lasting until the end of the caster's turn (up to 4 global turns). The effect cannot be dispelled. In this form, the caster is immune to all DMG, can't be healed, won't be the primary target of attacks, deals increased DMG, and reduces Technique CD by 2 turns. (The caster dies immediately if failing to win when Shadow Form ends, ignoring any effects that would preserve HP.)

10589.name: Potential Vitality
10589.description: Increases the caster's healing received for every 15% HP lost. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

10590.name: Soulfire Protection
10590.description: Before battle starts, consumes 50% of the caster's current HP to grant the caster a DMG Reduction effect. This effect cannot be dispelled.

10591.name: Soul Pact Resonance
10591.description: Grants an ATK boost when the caster has a summon on the battlefield.

10592.name: Iron Will
10592.description: Enemies affected by Taunt deal reduced DMG to the caster.

10593.name: Holy Aegis
10593.description: Increases the caster's DEF. Increases the effectiveness of DEF-based shields granted by the caster.

10594.name: Soul Breaker
10594.description: Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 15% HP lost of the target. Stacks up to 5 times.

10595.name: Sharp Feathers
10595.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 40% chance to summon 1 Wind Orb.

10596.name: Frostsoul Ward
10596.description: Increases the caster's Water Affinity. When attacked, there's a 70% base chance to inflict Wet on the attacker for 2 turns.

10597.name: Fiery Rejuvenation
10597.description: At the end of the caster's turn, if there are grounds inflicted with Burn within 2 grids of the caster, heals the caster once. Increases the healing power by 10% for each additional Burning grid in the area. Stacks up to 5 times.

10598.name: Cyclone Lament
10598.description: Increases the caster's Wind Affinity. Each time the caster's Technique deals Wind DMG to an enemy, there is a 35% base chance to inflict Laceration for 1 turn.

10599.name: Explosive Spirit
10599.description: For every Fire Technique cast, increases the caster's Crit Rate for 2 turns. Stacks up to 8 times.

10600.name: Soulbond Restoration
10600.description: When the caster's summon dies or expires, heals the caster once.

10601.name: Phantom Light
10601.description: Increases the caster's healing effects. When a Technique's healing overflows, converts 100% of the overheal into a shield for the target, lasting 2 turns.

10602.name: Elemental Harmony
10602.description: For each element among equipped Techniques that deal DMG, increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Stacks up to 4 times.

10603.name: Soul Spark
10603.description: Increases the ATK of the caster's summons but reduces their duration by 2 turns. (Summons last at least 1 turn; this Charm does not affect summons without a turn limit.)

10604.name: Rapid Cast
10604.description: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Before battle starts, reduces the CD of all Techniques by 1 turn. (Techniques already off cooldown are not affected.)

10605.name: Frost Guard
10605.description: At the end of the caster's turn, if no Technique was cast this turn, the caster enters the Icebound status, which reduces DMG taken and lasts until the start of the caster's next turn. This status heals the caster once before it expires.

10606.name: Frigid Glint
10606.description: Increases the caster's Water Affinity. Each time the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, there is a 100% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cold for 2 turns.

10607.name: Frigid Aura
10607.description: When an enemy ends their turn within 2 grids of the caster, there is a 100% chance to trigger Frigid Aura, dealing Water DMG once, with a 50% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cold for 2 turns.

10608.name: Spirit in Fire
10608.description: Reduces DMG taken during the caster's turn.

10609.name: Tactical Adaptation
10609.description: When there are 3 or fewer enemies within 2 grids, increases the caster's DMG dealt. When there are more than 3 enemies within 2 grids, reduces the caster's DMG taken.

10610.name: Mantra of Blessings
10610.description: At the start of the caster's turn, grants Blessing to the allied character with the highest ATK, increasing their DMG. This effect lasts until the start of the caster's next turn and cannot be dispelled.

10611.name: Falling Dark Star
10611.description: At the start of the caster's turn, the caster gains 1 random buff that lasts until the start of the caster's next turn.

10613.name: Healing Shift
10613.description: Increases healing received. Instead of restoring HP, all healing is converted at a 1:1 ratio into a shield for 2 turns. When the shield disappears, any remaining shield strength is converted 1:1 back into HP.

10614.name: Punishment Sigil
10614.description: Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique DMG, there's a 100% base chance to inflict Sigil.

10615.name: Holy Restoration
10615.description: Each Light Technique cast grants 1 stack of Renewing Light. At 6 stacks, heals the caster once.

10616.name: Holy Recuperation
10616.description: At the end of the caster's turn, if no Techniques were cast this turn, heals the caster once and increases DMG dealt next turn by 50%.

10617.name: Sacred Rhythm
10617.description: From the caster's 3rd turn onward, increases DMG dealt at the start of each turn. Stacks up to 3 times.

10618.name: Windless Lord
10618.description: Increase DMG dealt by the caster's Wind Orbs. Each time a Wind Orb is generated, there's a 70% chance to generate another, up to 4 times per turn.

10619.name: Tempest Edge
10619.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Crit DMG to an enemy, causes additional Wind DMG once.

10620.name: Dominant Gaze
10620.description: Deals increased Technique DMG to targets above 70% HP.

10621.name: Shadowstep
10621.description: Within a single turn, each time the caster loses over 10% of max HP, reduces DMG taken and increases SPD for 2 turns. Stacks up to 5 times.

10622.name: Flaming Heel
10622.description: After actively moving, deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the caster.

10623.name: Scarlet Zeal
10623.description: Each Technique cast grants a stack of Battle Zeal and increases the caster's ATK. At 6 stacks, Battle Zeal converts to Scarlet Zeal, greatly increasing the caster's ATK for 2 turns. (Battle Zeal doesn't stack while Scarlet Zeal is active.)

10624.name: Thunder Judgment
10624.description: When an enemy within 5 grids of the caster casts a Technique, there's a 50% chance to trigger Thunder Strike, dealing Light DMG once. The chance increases to 100% if the target is inflicted with Electro or Wet.

10625.name: Thunderbolt Mark
10625.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Light DMG to an enemy, there is a 65% base chance to inflict Electro.

10626.name: Radiant Warp
10626.description: Increases the caster's DMG RES. When taking Technique DMG, there's a 50% chance to teleport to any empty grid within 4 grids of the caster. Can trigger only once per turn.

10627.name: Ember Flare
10627.description: Increases the caster's Fire Affinity. Killing an enemy has a 30% chance to place 1 Blast Spirit on the spot.

10628.name: Vital Rhythm
10628.description: At the start of the caster's turn, gains 1 stack of Rhythm if the caster's HP is above 30%. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

10629.name: Soulweave
10629.description: When 3 of the caster's summons die or disappear, summons 1 Infernal Fiend in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Charm can only trigger once per battle.)

10630.name: Shadowy Current
10630.description: Increases the caster's Dark Affinity. Killing an enemy deals additional Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid where DMG is dealt.

10631.name: Ring of Omen
10631.description: At the start of the caster's turn, reduces Effect RES of all enemies within 5 grids of the caster. This effect is unique. Also there's a 50% base chance to inflict Vulnerability for 1 turn.

10632.name: Rejuvenating Elixir
10632.description: Carries 3 potions at the start of battle. When an allied character's HP falls below 50%, uses a potion to heal them. Produces 1 potion every 3 turns, holding up to 5 at a time.

10633.name: Cursed Armor
10633.description: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, there's a 50% base chance to inflict Erosion on the attacker.

10634.name: Power of Retribution
10634.description: Increases the caster's Physical Mastery. Each time the caster's Technique deals Physical DMG to an enemy, there is a 70% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cripple for 2 turns, up to 3 stacks.

10635.name: Skyglow
10635.description: Increases Light Affinity. At the end of the caster's turn, gains 2 stacks of Charge, up to 20 stacks. Cannot be dispelled.

10636.name: Sacred Blessing
10636.description: For each equipped Technique deals Light DMG, reduces DMG taken, up to 3 stacks. Cannot be dispelled.

10637.name: Ice Shackles
10637.description: Before battle starts, awakens the caster's power. The caster and all allied characters within 5 grids take reduced DMG from enemies inflicteded with Cold. Each stack of Cold on the target increases this reduction by 20%. This effect is Unique and cannot be dispelled.

10638.name: Tide Sigil
10638.description: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, gains 1 Tide Sigil. At 15 stacks, counterattacks and deals Water DMG once based on DEF to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

10639.name: Fortified Shell
10639.description: Increase the caster's DEF for every 10% HP lost. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

10640.name: Eidolon Whisper
10640.description: Increase the caster's summon's ATK. At the start of the caster's turn, advances the action bar by 30% for the caster's 1 random summon within 5 grids of the caster.

10641.name: Pact Hex
10641.description: At the end of the caster's summon's turn, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of that summon.

10642.name: Sage's Shelter
10642.description: When healing an ally with a Technique, reduces DMG taken for that target for 1 turn. This effect is Unique.

10643.name: Hex Edict
10643.description: Each time the caster's Technique inflicts a Debuff on an enemy, there is a 50% base chance to also inflict 1 stack of Erosion.

10644.name: Nightshade Soulplate
10644.description: Reduces DMG taken of the caster. At the end of the caster's turn, immediately triggers 1 inflicted Erosion within 5 grids of the caster.

10645.name: Veritas Pact
10645.description: After casting 8 Dark Techniques, the caster enters Nether Pact for 2 turns. Cannot be dispelled. During this state, DMG dealt is increased, and all Technique DMG gains 10% Lifesteal. (Techniques cast during Nether Pact do not count)

10646.name: Surging Tide
10646.description: Increase the caster's Elemental RES. Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, there is a chance to trigger Surging Tide, and advance the action bar by 20%, up to 2 times per turn. The initial trigger chance is 0%, and each equipped skill that deals Water DMG increases it by 5%.

10647.name: Riptide
10647.description: After casting 5 Water Techniques, the caster enters Tideform for 2 turns. Cannot be dispelled. During this state, DMG dealt is increased. After each Technique cast, there is a 30% chance to reset its cooldown and cast again, up to 2 times per turn. (Techniques cast during Tideform do not count)

10648.name: Pyre of Souls
10648.description: Every 3 turns, increase the DMG dealt by Blast Spirit of the casteronce, up to 2 times. Cannot be dispelled. The caster's Blast Spirit gains Enhanced Effect.

10649.name: Omnirune Sigil
10649.description: Whenever the caster uses a damaging Technique, conjures 1 matching elemental Rune next to the caster to increase the corresponding stat of the caster. Cannot be dispelled.

10650.name: Rupture Storm
10650.description: Increases Laceration DMG. When the caster's Technique sends an enemy from a normal state into Airborne, triggers Laceration once.

10651.name: Glare Fusion
10651.description: Increases Light Affinity. Each time the caster uses a Light Technique, gains 1 to 3 stacks of Energy at random. On every 4th Light Technique cast, removes all stacks of Energy and increases this Technique's DMG by 8% per stack. (The 4th cast does not grant Energy.)

10652.name: Grim Pursuit
10652.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 40% chance to deal additional Physical DMG once. For every 5% HP lost by the target, this skill deals 5% more DMG, up to 50%.

10653.name: Razor Momentum
10653.description: Increases the caster's Physical Mastery. Each time the caster's Technique deals Physical DMG to an enemy, there is an 80% chance to grant the caster 1 stack of Razor until the end of your turn, up to 20 stacks.

10654.name: Zephyr Battle Zeal
10654.description: For each Wind Orb the caster has, Technique DMG increases, up to 10 stacks. Cannot be dispelled.

10655.name: Ruinblight
10655.description: The caster's Single-Hit Techniques deal more DMG. For each type of Ailment or Debuff on the target, this effect increases by 10%, stacking up 5 times.

10656.name: Hellblood Frenzy
10656.description: Before battle starts, the caster enters Overdrive for 3 turns. Cannot be dispelled. During this state, DMG dealt is increased. When Overdrive ends, the caster enters Exhausted for 3 turns. Cannot be dispelled. While Exhausted, DMG taken increases by 100%.

10657.name: Blight Armor
10657.description: For each type of Ailment or Debuff on the caster, reduce DMG taken, stacking up to 5 times. Cannot be dispelled.

10658.name: Iron Solidarity
10658.description: Before battle starts, grants Solidarity to the caster and all allied characters within a 3-grid square area of the caster. This effect is unique and cannot be dispelled.

10659.name: Divine Bulwark
10659.description: Increases the caster's Effect RES. When the caster is knocked back or pulled, there is a 50% chance to gain Invincibility, becoming immune to that movement effect.

10660.name: Bulwark Will
10660.description: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, increases DEF for 1 turn, stacking up to 10 times, with a 20% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 on the attacker for 2 turns.

10661.name: Covenant Aegis
10661.description: Before battle starts, forms an undispellable Covenant with all allied Adventurers within 5 grids of the caster. When an allied Adventurer's HP first drops below 40%, the Covenant triggers for 1 turn. During this time, the caster intercepts enemy Technique DMG (True DMG) dealt to that allied Adventurer and takes reduced DMG.

10662.name: Energy Flux
10662.description: At the start of battle, the caster gains 14 stacks of Charge. Consuming 2 stacks of Charge increases the caster's ATK for 2 turns, stacking up to 7 times.

10663.name: Frost Domain
10663.description: Increases the caster's Water Affinity. Enemies ending their turn within 2 grids of the caster have a 100% base chance to be inflicted with 1 to 3 random stacks of Cold for 2 turns.

10664.name: Deathrattle
10664.description: When a duration-limited Summon dies or expires, grants a Shield based on the caster's Max HP to 1 Summon with unlimited duration for 2 turns. (Only affects the caster's own Summons.)

10665.name: Soulbinder
10665.description: In battle, the first Summon with unlimited duration created by the caster takes reduced DMG and deals increased DMG.

10666.name: Soul Corrosion
10666.description: Increases the caster's Erosion DMG. Whenever a Technique deals Dark DMG to an enemy inflicted with Erosion, there is a 100% chance to immediately trigger Erosion once.

10667.name: Cursed Link
10667.description: Whenever a Technique successfully inflicts a Debuff on enemies, there is a 50% chance to deal Dark DMG once to them.

10668.name: Elixir Mastery
10668.description: Each Potion carried increases the caster's Healing effect. Potion brewing speed increases to 1 Potion every 2 turns for the caster, and Healing from the caster's Potions is increased by 50%.

10669.name: Guardian Totem
10669.description: At the start of the caster's 3rd turn, summons 1 Guardian Totem in front of the caster that immediately acts. This Summon inherits a portion of character stats. The Guardian Totem cannot take DMG from enemies and cannot be healed.

10670.name: Temporal Swiftness
10670.description: Increases the caster's SPD. At the end of the caster's turn, there is a 40% chance to randomly reduce the CD of 1 Technique still on cooldown by 1 turn.

10671.name: Starfire Edge
10671.description: At the start of the caster's turn, the caster gains 2 stacks of Blade Soul, stacking up to 4 times. Cannot be dispelled.

10672.name: Ironclad
10672.description: Before battle starts, awakens the caster's power. Reduces DMG taken by the caster, with this effect increased by an additional 200% until the end of the caster's second turn.

10673.name: Shadow Stealth
10673.description: At the end of the caster's turn, gains 1 stack of Umbra. Triggers at 2 stacks, heals the caster once, and then the caster enters Stealth for 1 turn. Cannot be dispelled. (Umbra stacks cannot be gained while in Stealth).

10674.name: Shadow Shatter
10674.description: After actively moving, inflicts 1 stack of Shatter on all enemies within 1 grid of the caster for 1 turn, stacking up to 3 times.

10675.name: Bloodlust Zeal
10675.description: At the start of the caster's turn, inflicts a Battle Zeal mark on the enemy that dealt the most DMG to the caster in the previous turn, lasting until the end of the caster's turn.

10676.name: Frost Undertow
10676.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to deal additional Water DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Immobilize for 1 turn.

10677.name: Phoenix Rise
10677.description: When taking lethal DMG for the first time, forces the caster to survive with 1 HP and enter the Immolation state. Simultaneously absorbs all allied Burn effects within 3 grids of the caster. For each Burn absorbed, grants the caster a Shield based on the caster's Max HP, lasting until Immolation ends.

10678.name: Scorching Resonance
10678.description: For every allied Burn grid within 4 grids of the caster, increases the caster's Fire Affinity, stacking up to 10 times.

10679.name: Void Gale
10679.description: Increases the caster's Wind Affinity. Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there is a 10% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

10680.name: Gale Scar
10680.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to deal additional Wind DMG once, with a 5% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cripple for 2 turns, up to 3 stacks.

10681.name: Sigil Resonance
10681.description: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Up to 2 Runes of each element can exist simultaneously, with a maximum of 5 Runes active at once.

Can trigger only once per turn.
